description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements multiple interfaces related to a SQLite-based key-value store, including functions for data management, cache control, inspection, and storage limits. It includes methods for setting, getting, deleting data, managing namespaces, and handling database integrity and backup operations.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing a SQLite-backed key-value store with namespace and limit management, supporting data operations, cache control, and database integrity checks.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes the temporary journal directory to prevent filesystem corruption.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs a database integrity check and marks the database as corrupt if needed.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database and initializes schema and triggers.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.
